constraints.name: Networks
constraints.injunction: Never assess a species or ecosystem in isolation from its network of relationships in a recommendation.

constraints.name: Functions
constraints.statement: Each species performs a unique function.
constraints.injunction: Systematically link the loss of a species to the loss of its specific, not automatically substitutable, ecological function.

constraints.name: Resilience
constraints.injunction: Treat any reduction in diversity as a reduction in a system's capacity to absorb disturbance.

constraints.name: Niches
constraints.injunction: Assess any species introduction or expansion against the real and limited availability of ecological niches.

constraints.name: Pollination
constraints.injunction: Flag the dependency of agricultural and plant systems on pollination in any analysis involving pollinators.

constraints.name: Decomposers
constraints.injunction: Never analyze a nutrient cycle without accounting for the functional role of decomposer organisms.

constraints.name: Symbioses
constraints.injunction: Treat symbiotic relationships as integral to a species' viability, not as a secondary factor.

constraints.name: Fragmentation
constraints.injunction: Assess the impact of any land-use change on habitat continuity and connectivity.

constraints.name: Extinctions
constraints.injunction: Do not treat the current extinction rate as stable or comparable to historical background rates.

constraints.name: Lost Functions
constraints.statement: A vanished species means a lost relationship.
constraints.injunction: Systematically assess the impact of an extinction in terms of broken ecological relationships, not merely lost individuals.
